frontier_selector.why: The presence of a right anterior mediastinal mass and biopsy results showing epithelial malignancy of thymic origin specifically support Thymic Carcinoma.

support_spans: Right anterior mediastinal mass, well demarcated with minimal contact with surrounding great vessels and no adjoining abnormal lymph nodes
Epithelial malignancy of thymic origin, showing ovoid-to spindle neoplastic cells with nuclear atypia and mitosis
Serial Troponin-T measurements showed progressive elevation, reaching 1101 ng/L on day 4
Sinus tachycardia with mildly elevated ST-segments at the inferior leads
contradict_spans: Normal left atrial and ventricular sizes, good left ventricular contractility, no pericardial effusion or regional wall motion abnormalities

support_spans: Bilateral fine reticular opacities, widened mediastinum, cardiomegaly, and bilateral blunted costophrenic angles
oxygen saturation of 68% under ambient air
heart rate of 114 beats per minute
Diffusely slow coronary flow with patency in all three coronary arteries
